hypotheses: JQ1-S is a BRD4 bromodomain inhibitor; donor compounds with direct chromatin-reader or epigenetic-modifier pharmacology are most likely to reproduce a histone-mark perturbation in A375.
GSK525762A (I-BET762) is a BET bromodomain inhibitor with high structure similarity to JQ1-S and may transfer a similar H3K79me0/H3K56me0/H3K79me1 response pattern.
UNC1215 is an L3MBTL methyl-lysine reader antagonist and may perturb histone methylation marks, making it a plausible chromatin-directed donor.
Geldanamycin is an HSP90 inhibitor that can indirectly alter chromatin and histone modification states, so its pharmacology may be relevant for a reproducible histone perturbation.
Dasatinib and vemurafenib are kinase inhibitors with low anchor similarity; they are included only to test whether non-epigenetic kinase inhibition can transfer the JQ1-S histone signature.
object.evidence_gap: No donor has a measured A375 histone response profile in the provided data; donor selection is based on pharmacology and similarity scores, and the actual target-minus-A375 transfer values must be retrieved or measured before a reproducible >0.5 log2 histone perturbation can be claimed.
